reliance proof: with the product-side trigger removed (fixture only) an Inactive product with an ACTIVE SKU becomes possible — SKU-side triggers do not cover it, so the single product-side trigger carries this invariant
two overlapping approved PM BOM revisions make activation (and the pre-check) RAISE AMBIGUOUS_PM_BOM_REVISION — fail-closed, but a raw exception rather than a listed 'missing' item
as-of uses the IST calendar day, not UTC (20:00 UTC on 14 Nov = 15 Nov IST) when it is later than the period valuation date
a LATER governed valuation date beats today's IST date (greatest rule)
once IST today passes the latest valuation date, today wins again (20:00 UTC 28 Feb = 1 Mar IST)
a direct (non-RPC) deactivation leaves NO lifecycle audit event but IS captured in the live change log with actor_user_id NULL
audit rows are append-only in behaviour: later edits add rows and never rewrite earlier snapshots

the batch-size essential has NO resolver function: it is an inline predicate inside the helper, so a horizon check needs a reviewed date-parameterised contract (or one narrow internal function) for that essential
